notes.value: MEMBERSHIP IS A HARD KNOCK-OUT. To join UniBank a person must 'Be either: Employed by, or retired from an Australian university; Studying or have graduated from an Australian university; Immediate family to a UniBank member', and must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident. UniBank is 'exclusively for students, staff and graduates of Australian universities'. To open a membership or account for a child, the parent or guardian must already be a member. NOTE for panel routing: Teachers Mutual Bank Limited runs four brands off one balance sheet with 'consistent rates and policies' — UniBank (university sector), Teachers Mutual Bank (education), Firefighters Mutual Bank (emergency services) and Health Professionals Bank (healthcare). A client who fails UniBank's eligibility test may still qualify under a sibling brand, and one broker accreditation covers all four.

gaps: BROKER CHANNEL CONFIRMED. unibank.com.au/broker invites brokers to 'Get accredited with the member-owned bank supporting academics and alumni and their families, and the brokers who serve them', with upfront valuations, digital VOI and e-signing, and states that one accreditation unlocks four member-focused brands with consistent rates and policies. Broker support is on 1300 862 265.

NO PUBLIC CREDIT POLICY. UniBank and Teachers Mutual Bank Limited do not publish a broker lending policy or credit policy guide outside a broker login. The only Teachers Mutual Bank Limited lending reference guide found online was a 2021 copy hosted on an aggregator/broker-group website, which the research brief forbids using as a source, so it was not used.

NOTHING NUMERIC WAS SOURCED. No maximum LVR, LMI threshold, loan amounts, loan term, servicing buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, income-type shading, employment tenure, credit-history or security policy could be sourced from a public no-login page. The UniBank and Teachers Mutual Bank Target Market Determinations (e.g. Classic Home Loan, Classic Investor Home Loan, Your Way Plus Home Loan) exist at unibank.com.au/-/media/global/target-market-determinations/ but returned HTTP 404/403 to automated retrieval — these are the highest-value next targets for LVR, LMI and distribution-channel facts.

MEMBERSHIP KNOCK-OUT: employed by or retired from an Australian university; studying at or graduated from an Australian university; or immediate family of a UniBank member. Plus Australian citizenship or permanent residency.

A client failing UniBank eligibility may fit a sibling Teachers Mutual Bank Limited brand (Teachers Mutual Bank / Firefighters Mutual Bank / Health Professionals Bank) on the same policies — those brands should be researched as separate records.

Trade commentary suggests the TMBL brands take 'a common sense approach to shift work and allowances' tailored to their industries, which would matter for overtime and shift-allowance shading, but no percentage is published.
